articles.title: New Zealand reach Women’s Rugby League World Cup final as Waaka hat-trick sinks Samoa
articles.summary: Kiwi Ferns defeat Fetu Samoa 32-0 in semi-final. Centre Waaka scores three of Kiwi Ferns’ seven tries. A Stacey Waaka hat-trick has helped secure New Zealand their place in the Women’s Rugby League World Cup final.
body: The Kiwi Ferns were rarely threatened in their 32-0 victory over an inexperienced Fetu Samoa in Newcastle, running away with it late with four tries in the final 12 minutes on Saturday afternoon. Dual international Waaka made the most of her opportunities, setting up New Zealand’s early first try, before securing three of her own. With her hat-trick, Waaka drew level with Australia winger Jaime Chapman atop the tournament’s tryscoring tally with nine.
New Zealand will now face the winner of Sunday afternoon’s semi-final between Australia and Fiji in Brisbane next weekend, as they look to avenge their 54-4 loss to the Jillaroos in the 2021 final.

The Kiwi Ferns drew first blood within two minutes, capitalising on a Samoan error to send winger Mackenze Wiki over out wide. In an otherwise error-marred first half, the Samoans had the better of the chances, but failed to register points in good territory.

The research made headlines for its focus on reproductive behaviour, specifically the male’s urgent and very willing engagement in what is known as sexual cannibalism, AKA copulatory suicide.

Scientists observing these tiny arachnoids discovered that during the act of lovemaking with the larger, more decorative female, the male will perform a spectacular sexual death-somersault, flipping himself upside down, presenting his underbelly to the female’s fangs, and urging her to literally consume his intestines mid-coitus as an energy snack and self-dooming sweetener. articles.title: Dončić dazzles with 53 in Lakers’ win as LeBron held to eight in Cleveland return
articles.summary: Dončić scores 53 as Lakers hold off Portland. James struggles against former team in Cleveland. Tatum pours in 34 as Celtics rout Hornets. Luka Dončić scored 53 points and hit a key jumper in the lane with 28 seconds to play, carrying Los Angeles to a victory over Portland.
body: Dončić produced his 11th career 50-point game and his fourth with Los Angeles while preserving a fourth straight win for the Lakers, whose late 12-point lead had dwindled to four before Dončić and Austin Reaves combined to score 10 points in the final seconds.
Reaves scored 25 points and Walker Kessler had 16 points and 12 rebounds for the Lakers, who avenged a 136-129 home loss to Portland on October 27 with this NBA Cup victory.

Dončić scored 20 points in the third quarter alone to hit 40 for the sixth time in an incredible seven-game surge that includes six 40-point games – including four straight – and a 37-point performance.
The Slovenian superstar added five assists and five rebounds, giving him seven consecutive games with at least 35 points, five assists, five rebounds and five three-pointers.

articles.title: Magomedov beats Gabriel in ONE Championship to stay perfect
articles.summary: Magomed Magomedov maintained his perfect fight record in his ONE Championship debut, earning a split-decision victory over Lucas Gabriel in their lightweight MMA matchup on ONE Fight Night 49.
body: Magomedov entered the main event at Bangkok's Lumpinee Stadium on Friday night with an unblemished 15-0 record, stepping in at short notice to replace the injured Alibeg Rasulov.

Gabriel, meanwhile, came in boasting an 11-1 record and an unbeaten run in ONE Championship. But once the opening bell rang, Magomedov wasted little time pursuing a takedown and managed to bring Gabriel to the canvas.
The second round followed a similar pattern, with Magomedov immediately pressing forward in an attempt to take the fight back to the mat.
This time, Gabriel fared better in the scrambles and managed to keep himself out of danger.

body: Joshua Buatsi and Willy Hutchinson renew their rivalry for the vacant WBC world light-heavyweight title in Manchester on Saturday.
The British rivals first met in a highly entertaining, hard-fought contest on the undercard of Daniel Dubois' win over Anthony Joshua in September 2024.
Londoner Buatsi, 33, twice knocked down Hutchinson before going on to win by split decision.
Scotland's Hutchinson, 28, suffered the second defeat of his professional career that night but two wins since have put him in a position to fight for a first world title.

articles.title: LeBron held to single digits for only 10th time on Cleveland return
articles.summary: LeBron James was held to single-digit points for only the 10th time in 1,630 NBA regular-season games as his Philadelphia 76ers were beaten on his return to face his former team the Cleveland Cavaliers.
body: James was held to eight points as the Cavaliers routed the 76ers 119-95 in an NBA Cup group stage game.

The 41-year-old, a native of Akron, Ohio, who elected to sign with Philadelphia in the offseason, instead of returning to Cleveland for a third stint, was 3 of 12 from the field, including 0 for 4 on three-pointers, while he committed six turnovers in 31 minutes.
"Definitely not feeling a good rhythm offensively," James said. "We didn't look like much offensively. We had a couple spurts, but too many turnovers on my behalf."
James received a smattering of boos from Cavaliers fans every time he touched the ball during the first half.

articles.title: I left Man City for my mental wellbeing - Trafford
articles.summary: James Trafford says not playing for Manchester City last season was "horrendous" and left him with no choice but to leave the club and join Leeds United in the summer.
body: City re-signed academy graduate Trafford in July 2025, two years after he had left the club to join Championship side Burnley.
But less than six weeks after his arrival, Italy international Gianluigi Donnarumma arrived from Paris St-Germain.
The 27-year-old, who helped the French club win the Champions League just weeks earlier, immediately became City's first-choice goalkeeper, leaving Trafford short of playing time.
After starting the first three matches of the campaign, 24-year-old Trafford made just one further Premier League start in the 35 games that followed Donnarumma's arrival.

articles.title: Non-league's greatest giant-killers eye another scalp
articles.summary: Non-league Altrincham aim to make Notts County number 18 on their list of FA Cup scalps, and breathe new life into their tag of English football's ultimate giant-killers.
body: "I honestly believe that we were the best non-league team ever. Look at that history - it should give the players the confidence that anything is possible."

With more than 500 appearances for Altrincham during its golden era of the '70s and '80s, Graham Heathcote knows all about the club's remarkable relationship with the FA Cup, and the giant-killing exploits that forged its identity.
One of the club's most legendary figures, he believes they can inspire the current team to pull off another upset against League One Notts County, despite being separated by two divisions.

Over the years, Altrincham - currently seventh in the National League - have defeated 17 Football League opponents in the competition, more than any other club that has spent its entire existence in non-league football.

articles.title: Arsenal youth trains with first-team amid senior international call-up
articles.summary: Arsenal youngster James Scanlon is having a good week, receiving call-ups to train with the Gunners first-team and to play with Gibraltar over the international break. Photo via Scanlon on Instagram.
body: Ahead of Arsenal’s game against Hull City on Saturday, 20-year-old winger James Scanlon was spotted training with Mikel Arteta’s senior side on Friday.

Arsenal are obviously a little low on wingers at the moment, with Bukayo Saka out of action through injury and Max Dowman suspended. With Scanlon scoring three goals and assisting one in his first five Premier League 2 appearances for the Gunners, he’s earned a chance in training.
But that wasn’t the only boost for the former Manchester United winger this week, as he’s also been called up to the Gibraltar senior squad for the November break.
The international call-up isn’t surprising, as Scanlon has already made 28 appearances for Gibraltar in his young career.

articles.title: Why No. 1 Miami is historic underdog vs. Notre Dame after head-scratching CFP rankings
articles.summary: 1 Miami is historic underdog vs. Notre Dame after head-scratching CFP rankings originally appeared on The Sporting News. Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here.
body: Miami and Notre Dame face off in a huge matchup this weekend, but despite being the top-ranked team in the country, the Hurricanes are heavy underdogs.

The first edition of this year's College Football Playoff rankings has Miami at the top, while the team has been No. 1 in the AP Polls and Coaches Poll for three straight weeks. However, despite that success as an undefeated team, bookmakers believe the Fighting Irish should win this game by a decent margin.

If Miami can pull off the upset in South Bend, the team cements itself as the clear-cut team to beat in the College Football Playoff. If they lose, though, Miami might not be punished too much considering the pressure appears to be on Notre Dame.

Miami enters Saturday as a 7.5-point underdog, according to DraftKings, a rarity for a team ranked No. 1 overall. That is especially the case after Notre Dame was placed at No. 11 in the College Football Playoff ranking, creating a 10-spot difference between the two sides.
